# RedShark News

> > Professional filmmaking, cinematography, and post-production technology news covering cameras, workflows, and production techniques.

RedShark News is a leading resource for film and video production professionals, featuring in-depth coverage of cinema cameras from manufacturers like Arri and Canon, production workflows, post-production tools, and emerging technologies. The site provides technical analysis, reviews, and practical guides for cinematographers and content creators.

## Key Topics

- Cinematography
- Post-production workflows
- Cloud production
- Arri cameras
- Canon equipment
- Storage technology (CFast 2.0, memory cards)
- Camera lenses and optics
- Audio recording and interfaces
- VR/AR technology
- AI-assisted production
- Camera stabilization
- Film grain and aesthetics
- Color grading and filtering
- Professional displays and monitors
- Production safety and preparation

- [Cooke goes large format with the Panchro 65/i Lens Series](https://www.redsharknews.com/cooke-goes-large-format-with-the-panchro-65/i-lens-series): Cooke Panchro 65/i large format lenses for Arri ALEXA 65 and URSA Cine 17K
- [Physical filters are still great, here's why](https://www.redsharknews.com/physical-filters-are-still-great-heres-why): Physical camera filters vs Resolve digital effects in cinematography
- [Is the standard lens just a myth?](https://www.redsharknews.com/production/item/3646-is-the-standard-lens-just-a-myth): Roland Denning examines standard lens focal length and field-of-view theory
- [New low-cost Zhiyun smartphone stabilizer still features AI & voice control](https://www.redsharknews.com/new-low-cost-zhiyun-smartphone-stabilizer-still-features-ai-voice-control): Zhiyun Cinepeer CQ5 smartphone gimbal with AI tracking and Hey Cami voice
- [Canon to close Zhuhai factory in China](https://www.redsharknews.com/canon-to-close-zhuhai-factory-in-china): Canon closes Zhuhai factory citing chip shortages and compact camera decline
